de.abas.erp.api.gui

Class MenuBuilder<T>

  • Object
    • MenuBuilder<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - The type of the menu item keys.

    public class MenuBuilder<T>
extends Object
    Helper class to build a GUI menu.
    Example usage: 
     MenuBuilder<Integer> mb = new MenuBuilder<Integer>("Menu-Title");
 mb.addItem(1, "Entry1");
 // Kontenbereich wählen
 mb.addItem(2, "Entry2");
 Integer choice = null;
 while ((choice = mb.show()) != null) {
   switch (choice) {
     case 1:
      // do something
      break;
     case 2:
      // do something
      break;
 }
    Author:
    male
